missingList: This wish list couldn’t be found or is no longer available.
intro: Found a gift you’d like to give? Reserve it to let others know.

unlock.heading: This wish list is password-protected
unlock.description: Enter the password shared with the wish list link.
unlock.passwordHint: Ask the person who shared the link with you.
unlock.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
unlock.passwordRequiredToFollow: Enter the list password again to follow it.

clickCategory: Select a category to jump to it.
reservedBody: You’ve reserved this gift. You’ll need to purchase it separately. It stays visible to you on this list.

reservation.cancelBody: This gift will be available to reserve again.

emptyFiltered: No gift ideas match these filters.
emptyList: This wish list has no gift ideas yet.
emptyHint: Try a different budget or recipient.
emptyListHint: Check back later for new gift ideas.

reserve.title: Reserve a gift
reserve.unavailable: This gift is no longer available (already reserved or missing).
reserve.privacyHint: People who manage this list can see your name and message.
reserve.noPurchaseHint: Reserving a gift doesn’t place an order. You’ll need to purchase it separately.
reserve.modeLabel: How would you like to give this gift?
reserve.modeSingleHint: You give this gift: it is no longer offered to others.
reserve.modeGroupHint: Others can chip in with you.

invite.title: Join a wish list
invite.body: Log in or create an account to join this list.
invite.joinHint: Joining this list lets you edit its gift ideas.
invite.alreadyMember: You’re already a member of this list.

subscription.unfollowBody: It will be removed from your followed lists. Any gifts you reserved on this list will stay reserved.
subscription.followedBody: You can find it anytime under “My wish lists”.

followNames.title: Rename this list
followNames.body: Only you can see these names.

groupGift.joinAria: Chip in for the group gift: {{name}}
groupGift.amountHint: For example 20 or 15.50. Nothing is paid here: the amount helps participants know what is left to gather.
groupGift.privacyHint: Other participants and people with the gift's link will see your name; participants will also see your amount and message. People who manage the list see your name and message, never your amount.
groupGift.noPurchaseHint: A group gift places no order and collects no money: agree among participants on who buys it.
groupGift.leaveBody: Your name, amount and message will be removed from the group gift. If you were the last one, the idea becomes available again.
groupGift.joinedTitle: You're chipping in for this group gift
groupGift.joinedBody: Nothing is paid here: agree with the other participants on the purchase.
groupGift.missing: This group gift no longer exists.
groupGift.missingHint: Its participants withdrew, or the list changed.
groupGift.markCompleteBody: It will no longer be offered to people who are not chipping in. Participants can reopen it.
groupGift.closed: This group gift is complete: you can no longer chip in.
groupGift.completeHint: The gift is complete: it is no longer offered to other people.
groupGift.inviteHint: Send this link to people who want to chip in with you: it shows this gift only, not the rest of the list.
groupGift.changeAmountHint: Leave it empty if you would rather not say.
groupGift.noAccountHint: With an account, you could change your amount and talk with the other participants.
groupGift.threadHint: Only participants with an account read and write here. People who manage the list never see these messages.
